answer: Each identity grows on a trellis - a lattice of connections. Honest identities climb it in many directions, their vines intertwining with many neighbors. The network sends an echo through the trellis: each identity must answer a question only a true climber of that lattice can answer. A hollow identity has no echo - the sound passes straight through. From the horizon: honest ones are dense and varied, but a farm's trellises are identical hollow frames - same shape, same echo. To pass, a farm must grow a different trellis for every sockpuppet, each echoing truly - as expensive as honest work.
